data.name: Heppman
data.long_meaning: The name Heppman is derived from the Old German word 'heff' meaning 'to serve' or 'to lift'. This name was used as a surname for someone who managed or served a lord or was a servant in a monastery. The name can be considered a variant of the name Heinrich, which means 'ruler of the home'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes service and dedication to one's community or lord.
